test: sanitizes labels with the current dompurify config
rationale: Agentic retains authored text for editing and lowers formatted text without DOMPurify; native display/security tests cover its output.

test: should call getConfig at sanitization time, not at module load time
rationale: Native parser has no singleton configuration or DOMPurify call; request-local configuration is tested at render/layout boundary.

test: should read block.padding from config at call time, not at import time
rationale: Native layout accepts request-local padding directly; dedicated native regression verifies this behavior.

test: emits one composite rule per palette entry under a colour theme
rationale: Agentic uses typed Scene paint and its own theme tokens instead of Mermaid's generated CSS.

test: leaves the simple shapes to the flat theme colour
rationale: Mermaid stylesheet selector assertions do not describe the native Scene contract.

test: emits nothing for a theme that carries no palette
rationale: Mermaid stylesheet selector assertions do not describe the native Scene contract.

test: rejects a look that would break out of the selector
rationale: Native Scene style admission and SVG output security own this boundary; Mermaid selector generation is absent.
